en.title: Daily Accessibility Digest – May 8, 2026
en.summary: Today's top accessibility stories include an updated ADA website compliance deadline, VR training improving police interactions with autistic individuals, wheelchair users mapping 420km of accessible pathways in Townsville, concerns that Australia's EV future excludes drivers with disabilities, and South Australia's plan to speed up support for children with complex needs.

highlights.title: Compliance Deadline Changed for ADA Website Accessibility
VR training helps police improve interactions with people with autism
Wheelchair pilots map 420km of accessible pathways
Australia’s EV future excludes drivers with disabilities behind
Faster support for children with complex needs
